message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover featuring the title "TEMPO" in large, white, sans-serif letters across the top. Below the title is a smaller slogan: "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". At the top left, the words "LIPUTAN KHUSUS" appear, while the top right says "20 TAHUN REFORMASI" next to a small, rectangular photograph showing people and an Indonesian flag.

A large illustration occupies the center and right. It depicts a young child with a rounded face and pale skin, wearing a pink headscarf and a matching pink garment. The child holds a pink teddy bear in their right arm. In their left hand, the child holds a bundle of grey cylinders strapped together with wires and a small green electronic device with a digital display. The background behind the figure is a pale, clouded sky.

On the left side, bold black text reads "TIMANG TIMANG, BOOM...!" followed by a block of smaller grey text. The bottom left corner contains a barcode and publication details: "21-27 MEI 2018", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273".
